The patented, lightweight 7075-T6 billet aluminum receivers are not simply skeletonized and hollowed out but is carefully engineered with structural consideration. products.title: B&T XH-762 SUP 30CAL TI/INCONEL BLK
products.description: The XH-762 is a next-generation hybrid suppressor engineered for the higher pressures and demanding firing schedules of modern .30-caliber firearms, delivering an exceptional balance of lightweight handling, durability, and advanced signature reduction. Constructed from a 3D-printed titanium body paired with a rugged 718 Inconel blast baffle, the XH-762 withstands extreme heat and high-volume firing while minimizing unnecessary weight. Optimized with B&T's proven Reduced Backpressure System (RBS), the suppressor significantly reduces gas blowback and limits bolt-speed increases to under 2%, helping preserve weapon reliability and reduce wear on critical components. A specialized low-flash endcap further minimizes muzzle signature, enhancing situational awareness in low-light and tactical environments. Designed for demanding applications ranging from precision gas guns and AK platforms to law enforcement and military use, the XH-762 delivers refined sound suppression, superior flash mitigation, and reliable performance under the harshest operating conditions.

products.title: B&T XH556 RBS TI PRINT FULL GRY
products.description: The XH-556 sets a new standard in advanced suppressor design, specifically optimized for the higher pressures of 5.56 / .223 firearms. Using B&T's Reduced Backpressure System (RBS) along with a low-flash endcap, the XH-556 provides an innovative solution to the common challenges of gas blowback and muzzle flash encountered in other reduced-back-pressure designs.

products.title: B&T IMPULS-OLS TI 9MM SUPPRESSOR GRY
products.description: Renowned as one of the most trusted and widely used handgun suppressors worldwide, the B&T Impuls line has cemented its status with NATO special operations units and military forces across the globe. Why do so many manufacturers approve the Impuls series for use with their pistols? Because when they provide a suppressor with a handgun, any potential issues fall under the firearm manufacturer's responsibility-not the suppressor producer. As a result, most will only honor warranty claims if you're using a B&T Impuls suppressor.

products.title: BCM STOCK MOD 3 BLACK
products.description: Informed by years of overseas use during contingency events the BCM Mod 3 Stock is the newest refinement of the baseline M4 accessory. A minimalist snag free component, the BCM Mod 3 Stock has been shaved down to 6.4 oz. slick with an improved double-walled (H-Beam) construction to ensure reliability and durability during use. Two friction fit M3 marksman risers, approximately .5" and .8", have been designed to interface with the Mod 3. These risers can be mounted in six positions, and can be oriented either forward or reverse to provide the end user a unique flexibility in configuring their weapon system. When employed with the M3 optional marksman riser, the BCM Mod 3 Stock enables a consistent cheek weld when running electro-optics and low powered variable optics set up for passive night vision employment or close-quarter battle.
features: Removable Solid Diamond Textured Non-Slip Buttpad

products.title: BCM GUNFIGHTER KNSTHTC GRP PIC BLK
products.description: Bravo Company's BCM GUNFIGHTER KAG-1913 Kinesthetic Angled Grip, Picatinny 1913 Rail Version, is the end result of collaboration between BCM and Travis Haley, founder of Haley Strategic Partners and inventor of multiple weapons manipulation enhancements in the firearms industry. Designed to complement modern shooting grips, the Kinesthetic Angled Grip (KAG) uses a biomechanically efficient forward rake to create an interface for positive retention and joint relief to the wrist, elbow, and shoulder, allowing for smooth weapon manipulation without substantial increase to the girth of the weapon system. Textured on both front and back, the profile of the KAG creates a channel for consistent and positive engagement which translates directly into improved efficiency in weapons manipulation and target to target transitions. The new Patent Pending BCM Direct Mount Picatinny 1913 interface system was developed to be the most rigid, light-weight, and cost effective system available for Vertical Pistol Grips and Hand Stop type accessories. BCM has developed a patent pending anchor system that not only secures to the mounting surface, but spreads the energy and force throughout the accessory. Conventional mounting systems can allow for an increased amount of shifting and flexing of the accessory. The BCM direct mount interface system reduces those issues and offers a more secure lockup, eliminating play in the mounting surface.
features: Forward rake gives positive retention when using "C-clamp" method of handguard support
Works as a rest for supported firing positions

products.title: BCM KMR ALPHA 5.56 15" BLK
products.description: Bravo Company's BCM KMR ALPHA 15" KeyMod Free Float Handguard is manufactured from aluminum that is lightweight yet durable. It also features a proprietary patent pending mounting indexing and lock up system that mitigates 12:00 rail movement under heat generated from the barrel nut. Inner diameter is 1.3 inches and the outside is 1.5 inches flat to flat. The handguard flares forward (towards muzzle end) at the 3 and 9 O'clock positions approximately 1/4 inch and the actual length when measured to flare is 10.5 inches. The KeyMod interface system was developed by Eric Kincel (now the Director of BCMs' product development team) to work in parallel with the current picatinny system. In many applications it will advance modularity past the current 1913 rail system. The BCM KMR Alpha also allows for a larger range of modularity offering 4 different offset mounting positions between traditional 3, 6, 9 and 12:00 positions. In the most basic of applications the KeyMod system allows for universal modularity between various manufacturers of accessories and accessory rails. A big win for the trigger puller.

Most of the industry relies on a simple screw and backing nut for a mounting system. BCM has developed a patent pending anchor system that not only secures to the mounting surface, but spreads the energy and force throughout the accessory. products.title: BERGARA TIMBER 30-06 24" 4RD WAL
products.description: Although there are many rifles on the market today, Bergara wanted to focus on one thing: quality. Bergara's B-14 rifles were inspired by the desire to bring the quality that Bergara was known for in the custom rifle world to production rifles made for all hunters. In the B-14 rifle, you will find a level of craftsmanship that surpasses all of the other production hunting rifles on the market. The B-14 HMR rifle features their integrated mini-chassis molded into the stock to give the rifle repeatable bedding and accuracy. It also supports a fully free- floated barrel to achieve optimal precision. products.title: BERGARA B14R 22LR TRNR STL 18" 10RD
products.description: Bergara's team of experts has designed and built an incredibly accurate full size precision trainer. The Bergara B-14R Bolt Action Rifle was years in the making. The goal was simple: make the best production precision .22 possible for both beginners and seasoned competitors. The Bergara B-14R was a product that their customers and enthusiasts had been requesting for quite some time, and with their expertise, and the growing participation in NRL22 and PRS .22 competitive matches, they delivered a product that's on target and exceeded expectations. This rifle is designed as a true rimfire trainer is that it works within the dimensions of a REM700 platform, allowing shooters to have a similar size and feel to their centerfire rifle, or even set up as a clone to their centerfire to train with. It, therefore, fits REM700 compatible stocks, bases, and triggers. This being the case, it gives a perfect platform to allow any shooter the ability to customize their rifle with all kinds of compatible accessories already on the market. The magazine is a single stack magazine that is built within the same dimensions as a standard short action AICS mag. With the growing popularity of long-range shooting, this gun allows shooters to practice their disciplines at a more affordable price and in areas where longer ranges may not be available.

products.description: Although there are many rifles on the market today, they wanted to focus on one thing: quality. Bergara's B-14 rifles were inspired by the desire to bring the quality that Bergara was known for in the custom rifle world to production rifles made for all hunters. In the B-14 rifle, you will find a level of craftsmanship that surpasses all of the other production hunting rifles on the market. The B-14 Hunter rifle features a molded synthetic stock made of glass fiber reinforced polymer. As with the entire B-14 Series, the Hunter brings Bergara Barrel accuracy to a line of hunting rifles that is affordable to serious big-game hunters. Built in Spain at Bergara's highly automated and efficient barrel factory, this rifle delivers a level of quality and performance that is unmatched in its price range. The world-renowned Bergara barrel on this rifle for hunting whatever your heart desires is complemented by their own super-smooth B-14 Action, which is a two-lug system with a sliding plate extractor and a coned bolt nose and breech to ensure a smooth feeding and extraction of the cartridge. It's also outfitted with a Bergara curved trigger they designed to guarantee a crisp, clean pull every time you fire the rifle. The trigger comes set at about three pounds. It has been factory drilled and tapped to fit Remington 700 style rings and bases. The (#4) Bergara 4140 CrMo steel barrel has a Graphite Black Cerakoted finish. Their stocks are bedded with integral pillars for stability and enhanced accuracy. During the molding process, solid steel pillars are inserted and permanently molded into place, providing a secure and stable bedding surface for the barreled action. The base color is green with tan and black flecks, providing a very tasteful camo look. A SoftTouch coating gives the stock soft, tacky feel that is easy to grip even in harsh weather.

The muzzle is threaded 5/8-24" and includes a thread protector. A 5-round AICS detachable magazine is standard with the HMR rifle. QD flush cups are included in the stock to allow for easy attachment and detachment of slings.

products.title: BERGARA HMR WILDERNESS 308WIN 20" 5R
products.description: The Wilderness Series tackles the need for rifles that can withstand the rugged and unforgiving wilderness while blending into those very same elements - hence Bergara's hand-painted camouflage stocks with added webbing for increased texture and grip. All Wilderness Series barreled actions feature Sniper Grey Cerakote finishes for advanced protection in extremely harsh weather. The B-14 Wilderness HMR rifle features their integrated mini-chassis molded into the stock to give the rifle repeatable bedding and accuracy. This rifle is also outfitted with a Bergara Performance Trigger and a 5 round (3 round: 6.5 PRC) AICS style detachable magazine. The world-renowned (#6) Bergara barrel is finished in Sniper Grey Cerakote and features a seamless, omnidirectional, and multi-ported muzzle brake that will reduce felt recoil by up to 35 percent. The Wilderness HMR is complemented by their super-smooth B-14 Action, which is a two-lug system with a sliding plate extractor and a coned bolt nose and breech to ensure smooth feeding and extraction of the cartridge. It has been factory drilled and tapped to fit Remington 700 style rings and bases and includes QD flush cups, adjustable cheek piece and length-of-pull spacers.

products.description: Although there are many rifles on the market today, Bergara wanted to focus on one thing: quality. Bergara's B-14 rifles were inspired by the desire to bring the quality that Bergara was known for in the custom rifle world to production rifles made for all hunters. The B-14 HMR rifle features their integrated mini-chassis molded into the stock to give the rifle repeatable bedding and accuracy. It also supports a fully free- floated barrel to achieve optimal precision. The Bergara Hunting and Match rifles are built to offer a rifle for both hunters and competition shooters that can perform incredibly in either situation. The stock features an adjustable cheekpiece and length of pull spacers. Built in Spain at Bergara's highly automated and efficient barrel factory, this rifle delivers a level of quality and performance that is unmatched in its price range. The world-renowned Bergara barrel on this long-range precision rifle is complemented by their super-smooth B-14 Action, which is a two-lug system with a sliding plate extractor and a coned bolt nose and breech to ensure smooth feeding and extraction of the cartridge. It's also outfitted with a Bergara curved trigger they designed to guarantee a crisp, clean pull every time you fire the rifle. The trigger comes set at about three pounds. It has been factory drilled and tapped to fit Remington 700 style rings and bases. The (#6) Bergara 4140 CrMo steel barrel has a Graphite Black Cerakoted finish. The muzzle is threaded 5/8-24" and includes a thread protector. A 5-round AICS detachable magazine is standard with their HMR rifle. QD flush cups are included in the stock to allow for easy attachment and detachment of slings.

products.title: BERGARA HMR PRO 300PRC 26" 5RD THRDD
products.description: Think of the Premier Series as custom quality, but with standardized features for greater efficiencies in parts production and assembly - providing near custom performance at prices that are affordable to serious shooters. Bergara's Premium stainless steel barrels receive a proprietary honing process at their barrel-making facility in Bergara, Spain. Then, at the Bergara USA factory, the barrel receives a Tactical Grey Cerakote finish and is coupled with their proprietary Bergara PREMIER action, featuring a nonrotating gas shield, coned bolt nose, and sliding plate extractor. This action is designed as a two-lug system that features a separate floating bolt head to ensure contact with the lug abutments in the action. It also features a cone-shaped bolt nose for smooth feeding of the cartridge, and a spring-loaded sliding plate extractor located in the front of the lower locking lug. The one-piece bolt body is stainless steel with a pad at the rear to accept the threaded-in bolt handle. The bolt head, the non-rotating gas shield, the bolt handle, and bolt shroud are fully Nitrided for extreme durability, as well as its self-lubricating properties The two-position safety is part of the trigger assembly, which in the HMR Pro rifle is a TriggerTech Frictionless Release Technology trigger. One great feature of this combination allows the bolt handle not to lock in the closed position, which in turn allows the rifle to be unloaded while in the safe position. The HMR Pro offers three barrel lengths, 20", 24", and 26". The stock on the Bergara Premier HMR Pro (Hunting and Match Rifle) has an integrated mini-chassis for repeatable bedding. It supports a fully free-floated barrel. The stock has an adjustable cheek piece and length of pull spacers as well as integrated QD flush cup sling mounts and swivel mounts.

products.description: The Stache is a truly ambidextrous and modular IWB holster system that allows you to make it your own and tailor it to your needs. Featuring adjustable passive retention, drawing your firearm from the Stache is fast and seamless, yet secure. The Stache works with many of today's popular handguns with red dot sights mounted. It's also designed to work with the popular Discreet Carry Concepts Gear Clips (sold separately). Injection molding makes the Stache thin without sacrificing any strength, and keeps edges rounded and smooth. This along with great adjustability combine to make the Stache amazingly comfortable for all-day wear. Left-handed or right-handed, low or high, canted or straight - The Stache's adjustability makes it yours. Included is a 1.5" J-style belt clip for the holster. A 1.75" clip is sold separately for use with wider belts. If you need a modular and comfortable all-day wear inside-the-waistband holster that's made in America, the Blackhawk Stache is your next holster.

products.title: BL FORCE VICKERS AK SLING BK
products.description: The Standard AK Sling was designed from the ground up to be the perfect sling for the world's most prolific small arm to match the qualities of the AK - simple, durable, functional, and economical.  If you have been long dissatisfied with the issue canvas strap or can't seem to get commercial slings to fit right, this sling is for you. The Standard AK sling is what you want for your AK-47, AK-74, or other AKM Style Rifles. Blue Force Gear started with the Vickers Sling platform used by good guys the world over.  With over 200,000 in use with the US military, the Vickers Sling with its quick adjust technology has a track record of being combat proven. Like the Vickers Sling the Standard AK Sling can be instantly lengthened and shortened with no sling tail to get caught or parts to break. This allows close, secure weapon retention that can be carried all day, but instantly lengthened to be shouldered and fired without removing the weapon or untangling the sling. The Standard AK Sling comes with a Molded Universal Wire Loop threaded onto the front of the sling. Perfectly suited for the AK, the UWL attaches to the elongated eyelet on handguard retainer or gas block quietly and securely with nylon coated aircraft grade stainless steel cable. The UWL can also be passed through underneath the gas tube for left hand installation. The UWL is threaded on the front and can be removed for a more custom application.
features: Length is adjustable to different sized weapons with or without body armor

products.description: Sling hooks and clips are on borrowed time! The world no longer has to tolerate loud, jangly sling attachments, hooks that eat up aluminum and plastic eyelets, or hardware pieces that take too long to attach and remove. With the Patent Pending ULoop finally on the scene, the hook and clip extinction event has begun. The ULoop brings a level of versatility that is unmatched by any other sling hardware. Code named the Uber Loop it is a quick-detach version of our popular Universal Wire Loop, offering even faster and easier installation, especially on smaller eyelets found on HK, SIG and FN weapons. The ULoop can be installed almost anywhere - through eyelets, holes in railed handguards, and on KeyMod rails.  There's no need to have multiple sling attachments. The ULoop replaces all hooks, clips and connections. The ULoop can be installed in seconds and does not need to be removed from the sling.  To release the wire, push the wire loop down towards the body. Then push the exposed crimp ball from the opposite side out of the locking channel. Pull the loose end of the cable out of the body. From there, the wire can be inserted through eyelets, loops on weapons, holes or slots in rails / KeyMod.  Simply push the loose end of the cable back into the ULoop body and snap the cable back into the locking channel.

products.title: BANISH 22 .22CAL DT 1/2X28 BLK
products.description: The BANISH 22 is a lightweight, high-performance rimfire suppressor designed for .22-caliber rifles and pistols, including .22 Hornet, .17 HMR, and 5.7X28 firearms. Rated for full-auto fire, it's ideal for target shooting, small-game hunting, varmint control, and introducing new shooters to the sport. Made from durable titanium, the BANISH 22 weighs just 4.1 oz, measures 5 3/4 inches long, and uses a direct-thread 1/2X28 mount for easy attachment. Its eight precision-engineered baffles deliver impressive sound reduction while minimizing carbon and lead buildup, making cleaning easier and ensuring reliable long-term performance.
features: Rated for Rimfire Cartridges up to .22LR and even 5.7X28
Designed to Keep Lead Debris and Carbon at a Minimum

products.title: BANISH 338 .338CAL BLK
products.description: The BANISH 338 is built to tame hard-hitting .338-caliber rifles while delivering impressive sound and recoil reduction. Designed for cartridges such as .338 Lapua, .338 Weatherby, .338 Win Mag, 8.6 Blackout, and .338 Federal, this titanium and Inconel suppressor weighs just 17.5 oz and measures 9.1 inches. With up to 33 dB of sound reduction, a durable ported Inconel blast baffle, and precision-engineered titanium baffles, the BANISH 338 offers exceptional durability, minimal POI shift, and outstanding long-range performance. User-serviceable and easy to clean, it's a versatile suppressor built for big-bore shooters who want quieter, smoother shooting across multiple calibers.

products.title: BANISH 9K DT 1/2X28 BLK
products.description: The BANISH 9K is an ultra-compact, 3D-printed titanium 9mm suppressor engineered for maximum performance with minimal size and weight. Measuring just 4.1 inches long, 1.3 inches in diameter, and weighing only 2.7 oz, the BANISH 9K is one of the lightest and most compact 9mm suppressors available, making it ideal for concealed carry and everyday use. Despite its small footprint, it reduces 9mm sound levels to 132 dB at the ear and is rated for full-auto fire with subsonic ammunition. Its lightweight design eliminates the need for a Nielsen Device or booster assembly, allowing simple direct-thread installation in 1/2X28 or 13.5X1LH configurations for reliable, hassle-free performance.
features: Rated for Pistol Cartridges up to 9MM and even 300BLK
No Nielsen Device or Booster Assembly Required

products.title: BANISH 30 GOLD V2 .300 CAL BLK
products.description: The BANISH 30 GOLD-V2 is a premium .30-caliber suppressor engineered for shooters who demand lightweight performance, exceptional sound reduction, and easy maintenance. Rated for calibers from rimfire up to .300 RUM, it delivers an impressive 36 dB sound reduction and features a larger expansion chamber optimized for AR-10 platforms. Constructed from durable titanium alloy, the BANISH 30 GOLD-V2 weighs just 13 oz, measures 8.2 inches long, and utilizes an industry-standard 1.375X24 hub mount for quick-detach compatibility. Its 11-baffle design is fully user-serviceable, allowing for simple cleaning and hassle-free reassembly with keyed and indexed components.
features: Rated for Rifle Calibers up to .300 RUM

products.title: BANISH BACKCOUNTRY .300CAL BLK
products.description: The BANISH Backcountry is a compact, lightweight .30-caliber suppressor built for hunters and shooters who demand portability without sacrificing performance. Measuring just 5.5 inches long and weighing only 7.8 oz, this fixed-length suppressor is rated for calibers up to .300 RUM and delivers impressive sound reduction across popular hunting cartridges, including .308 Winchester and .300 Win Mag. Its six-baffle design provides hearing-safe performance in a rugged, backcountry-ready package. Featuring a versatile 1.375X24 universal mount, the BANISH Backcountry is available as a direct-thread suppressor or with an optional muzzle brake attachment for added flexibility in the field.
features: Rated for Rifle Calibers up to .300 RUM

products.title: BANISH BUCK 30 30CAL 5/8X24 HUB BLK
products.description: The BUCK 30 by BANISH is a rugged, affordable multi-caliber suppressor built for hunters who want reliable performance in the field. Rated for rifle calibers up to .300 Winchester Magnum, it's an ideal choice for everything from predator control to big-game hunting. Constructed from laser-welded stainless steel and featuring a durable tubeless design, the BUCK 30 measures 6.9 inches long, 1.54 inches in diameter, and weighs just 13.8 oz. An integrated accuracy baffle helps minimize point-of-impact shift, while the industry-standard hub mount provides versatile firearm compatibility. Despite its compact size, the BUCK 30 delivers impressive sound suppression, reducing a .308 from an 18-inch barrel to just 131 dB at the ear, for a quieter, more comfortable shooting experience.
features: Rated for Rifle Calibers up to .300 Win Mag
Great For Whitetail Hunting Across the Country

products.title: BANISH MEATEATER 30CAL 5/8X24HUB GRY
products.description: The MeatEater by BANISH is a lightweight, compact .30-caliber suppressor designed for hunters seeking exceptional recoil reduction, excellent sound suppression, and backcountry-ready performance. Rated for calibers up to .300 RUM, this titanium suppressor weighs just 10.3 oz and measures only 5.85 inches long. Its innovative anchor brake system lets shooters balance recoil reduction and sound suppression, cutting felt recoil by up to 40% in the open position and by 30% when closed for added sound reduction. Interchangeable muzzle cap inserts optimize performance for specific calibers, while the suppressor's compact design still delivers an impressive 32 dB of sound reduction for a quieter, more comfortable shooting experience.
features: Rated for Rifle Calibers up to .300 RUM
Caliber Specific Interchangeable Muzzle Cap Inserts

products.title: BANISH 45 45CAL BLK
products.description: The BANISH 45 is a versatile modular suppressor built for handguns and pistol-caliber carbines, from .45 ACP down to rimfire calibers. Constructed from lightweight titanium, it weighs just 9.6 oz in its compact 6.7-inch configuration or 11 oz in the full-length 8.6-inch setup. Its modular design lets shooters choose between eight or 12 baffles to balance size and sound suppression based on their needs. Fully user-serviceable from both ends, the BANISH 45 can be quickly disassembled for cleaning or reconfiguration. Interchangeable pistons (sold separately) provide broad compatibility across a wide range of pistol platforms, making the BANISH 45 an adaptable, all-in-one suppressor solution.
features: Rated for Rimfire and up to 45 ACP

products.title: BANISH 46 V2 W/MNT .460CAL BLK
products.description: The BANISH 46-V2 is a compact, lightweight suppressor built for serious big-bore performance. It is designed for calibers from .338 Lapua to .45-70 Government, .450 Bushmaster, and .44 Magnum, and it also handles popular pistol calibers like 10mm and .45 ACP with ease. Constructed from durable titanium, it weighs just 15.3 oz and measures only 8 inches long, delivering impressive maneuverability without sacrificing performance. products.title: BADGER COM MOUNT 30MM 1.54" TAN
products.description: The Condition One Modular Mount is Badger Ordnance's answer to a growing demand for modularity in optical platform mounting. With the ever-expanding options available to shooters in the accessory and electro-optic markets, Badger Ordnance saw the need for a mount that can make the most use of precious real estate on rifle platforms while acting as a centralized hub for attachments and not suffering from deflection seen on optics and lasers attached to handguards. The C1 Modular Mount offers the end user four accessory mounting points on the Unimount body both left, right, fore, and aft to suit a wide range of shooter's needs. Unlike traditional ring cap accessories, the C1 accessories can be located in the same height and offset throughout various main mount heights giving the shooter a more consistent offset throughout models. This variant of C1 Modular Mount is 1.54" which is the common height of in-line Night Vision Devices and commonly used in precision applications. For shooters who prefer a lower and more optimum cheek-weld while still maintaining direct pass-through of Night Vision Devices. Made from 7075-T6 aluminum Type III Hard Coat Anodized. Weight 5.0oz.
features: Modular Mount for Four Accessory Mounting Points

products.title: BADGER COM MAX 34MM 1.54" TAN
products.description: The C1 Max is the latest addition to our Condition One Modular Mount lineup. The C1 Max was designed ground up with the precision rifle shooter in mind. Borrowing from and blending our Max 50 Scope Ring and C1 Modular Mount designs, the C1 Max has 1" wide, six screw ring caps for increased coverage and clamp force on your optic. The C1 Max also uses a low profile hardened steel clamp foot and four machined #10 crossbolts with low-pro T20 heads to ensure your mount stays put under the harshest recoil and conditions. The C1 Max has no forward cantilever for those who find cantilevered designs difficult to achieve eye relief with some optic and short action rail combos. The C1 Max is compatible with most of the full line of C1 accessories and attachments (there are specific ARC and ACD models for C1 Max) and offers the full range of modularity and customization the Condition One Modular Mounts are known for.

products.title: BOND MSLR 5.56 30RD 16" BLK
products.description: Most Lever Action guns have a very long lever throw, so Bond Arms thought it would be cool to do a Short Lever Throw that would actually be smoother than the normal long throw.  They also thought that it would be cool to utilize all the new technologies in play over the last 60 years with the AR market and make it a magazine fed system. Little did they know that cycling a 5 round magazine was easy, but cycling a 30 round magazine with a lever gun was nearly impossible. Bond Arms spent over a year redesigning the lever system and actually came up with a very clever cam system that will aggressively extract a round out of a 30 round magazine with no problem and it allowed for a very short throw even with the longest rounds.  It was so good, they did a patent pending on this and several other things they discovered going through this design process.  Also, with all the interchangeable barrels they have with their current guns, they wanted to make it easily convertible to other calibers to add more cool factor. As soon as you cycle the lever and pull the trigger, you know you have just felt the future of Lever Action guns.
features: A rotating bolt for strength and precision

products.title: BOOTLEG SMUGGLER AMBI LOWER BLK
products.description: Machined out of 7075 Billet aluminum and designed to match their newly released Upper Receiver, The Smuggler is their exciting first step into Lower receivers. Weighing in at 9.85 ounces and MIL-SPEC Hard Anodized this lower receiver will stand the test of rigorous training while looking great for years to come. The top priority of any build is functionality and durability; however, they were not going to leave out the creature comforts that make a good lower into a great one. The Smuggler utilizes a fully enclosed trigger guard, lightly flared mag well and is ready to accept any Mil-Spec lower parts kit that fits your unique needs.

products.title: BLK PNT DUAL PNT SIG P365 AXG RH
products.description: The DualPoint is designed from the ground up to be the ultimate appendix holster. The overall footprint of the holster is minimized through the use of innovative molding techniques and design characteristics which provide a feature set unmatched by any other appendix holster on the market today. The one-piece design, folded from the trigger guard side, allows the incorporation of a side mounted strut loop that aids in concealment by pushing the grip of the firearm towards the body. This significantly reduces how much the gun prints. Featuring user adjustable retention as well as fully adjustable ride height and cant, you can customize the fit of the holster to find the perfect spot that is most comfortable for daily wear. A user attachable mag pouch called the Plus Pouch is also available for purchase and can be added onto the holster at any time. The DualPoint can also be converted to a minimal OWB carry platform, maximizing the value to the end user. All needed hardware to make this conversion is included in every box.

products.title: BERETTA 1301 COMP PRO KO 12/24/IC
products.description: After achieving several podium finishes at the last World Shotgun Championships with its unrivalled cycling speed, the 1301 Comp has evolved into the Pro version following the implementation of suggestions made by Beretta's multiple medal-winning shooters. With the comfort, stability and easy swing offered by the new stock, the ultra-fast, safe loading system, the new oversized cocking handle and bolt release lever, the 1301 Comp Pro is now, even in its standard configuration, the most competitive dynamic shooting platform,  but has plenty of capacity for further personalization and is therefore very sought after by the most demanding of shooters. The 1301 Comp Pro includes a new polymeric stock with the Kick-Off Plus system consisting of two elastomer dampeners complete with return springs, positioned near the rubber insert, which effectively mitigate the first recoil peak reducing the perceived recoil by up to 40%. A third elastomer dampener, located in the stock bolt, absorbs the impact of the slide against the stock, thus reducing the second recoil peak, muzzle jump and any vibrations caused by the movement of the slide. The B-Steady system divides the stock into two sections: Butt and forearm. The recoil absorption point is in an advanced position, moving in unison with the forearm, which is free to move back leaving the butt stable and avoiding any annoying rubbing of the comb against the cheek. The cheek remains still and rests perfectly without ever losing the line of fire.

products.title: BERETTA A300 ULTMA PTRL 12/19 GRY 5R
products.description: Similar to its hunting counterpart, the A300 Ultima Patrol utilizes a semiautomatic gas-operated action with a compensating exhaust valve, self-cleaning piston, and a chrome-lined barrel. The short, 19 1/2" barrel gives it a compact size and makes it ideal for engaging targets while in confined spaces. The A300 Ultima Patrol was built to be extremely reliable and easy to use. it features a large textured bolt release, an oversized charging handle, and a hefty safety button that can be switched from side to side. The checkering around the grip and fore-end ensures the operator will have a consistent grip on the weapon, even when wearing gloves. Aside from its ease of use and close range capabilities, the A300 Ultima Patrol is a highly customizable platform. A receiver mounted MIL-STD Picatinny rail allows for the installation of optics, and M-LOK attachment points on the forend and barrel clamp accommodates the use of tactical lights/lasers.

products.title: BERETTA APX-A1 FS PRTD 9MM 10RD FDE
products.description: Introducing the next evolution of the APX A1 family, the Beretta APX A1 Ported. Built for shooters who demand faster follow-up shots and superior control, this model features a precision ported barrel and slide system designed to tame recoil and keep your sights locked on target. A single angled port in the barrel, paired with seven ports in the slide, redirects gas upward, reducing muzzle rise and helping you stay flatter and shoot faster when it matters most. The APX A1 Ported also features oversized controls, including an enlarged magazine release and an ambidextrous slide release, engineered for quicker manipulation and confident operation under pressure. Optics-ready out of the box, the slide is cut to accept many of today's most popular pistol optics, giving you the flexibility to configure your pistol for competition, duty, or personal defense. Each APX A1 Ported ships with three magazines and the proven ergonomics and reliability that define the APX platform. Whether you're protecting what matters most or pushing for faster times on the range, the APX A1 Ported delivers the speed, control, and performance serious shooters demand.

products.title: BRN AB3 MICRO STALKER 243WIN 20"
products.description: Give smaller hunters the best shot at success with a top quality Browning rifle. The AB3 Micro Stalker offers all the performance hallmarks of a traditional Browning in an accurate and cost-effective design. Importantly, the AB3 Micro Stalker has three important features that make it perfect for a smaller framed shooter, whether it's a newer hunter or an adult with a smaller frame: First is the 13" length of pull stock that enables a shooter with shorter reach to comfortably put their firing hand on the grip for a relaxed trigger pull. Additionally, their support hand will more comfortably support the fore-end of the rifle, reducing strain-induced shaking that make it difficult to take a steady shot. Secondly is the shorter barrel length of 20" that reduces the weight on the front end of the rifle. Often, this extra weight makes it difficult for a smaller shooter to hold a rifle steady in an unsupported stance. Additionally, it's hard to move through cover with a proportionally longer gun relative to the size of the shooter. The barrel length reduction is just right - allowing better rifle handling without sacrificing too much velocity. Lastly, the Pachmayr Decelerator recoil pad. Pachmayr is a well-known name in the hunting industry, producing some of the softest and comfortable recoil pads you can get. They also have a partially tacky surface that reduces the chances of the stock slipping under recoil, potentially causing inadvertent and painful impacts to a learning shooter and hunter.
features: Compact dimensions fit many shooters better
Sporter contour barrel for the ideal blend of accuracy and weight savings

products.title: BRN XBLT2 COMPOSITE 308WIN 22" BLK
products.description: The X-Bolt 2 Hunter Composite rifle is built to impress in the woods, mountains, and at the shooting range with features designed to maximize performance. Like all X-Bolt 2 rifles, the Hunter Composite is built on a receiver design with additional bolt guidance surface for smooth, fast cycling. The bolt is built with weight-saving spiral fluting and a new handle knob. A light, sporter contour barrel offers a great blend of accuracy and weight savings. The muzzle is threaded M13x0.75 to accept the included radial muzzle brake, thread protector cap, or install an optional Browning Recoil Hawg Sporter muzzle brake for extra reduction in recoil. The action is bedded and the barrel is free floated for consistent accuracy. The DLX Trigger is a three-lever design that offers zero creep, zero take-up, and zero overtravel performance and comes preset from the factory at 3.5 pounds. (Adjustable down to 3.0 pounds.) The stand-out feature is, of course, the new Vari-Tech stock. This configurable stock makes it easy to adjust the comb height to dial-in the alignment between your eye and optics. Length of pull is adjusted internally with spacers for a solid, rattle-free feel. Even the grip angle can be changed by switching between the sporter and vertical grip modules. On the subject of grip, rubber overmolding on the gripping surfaces provides added security in all conditions. Coming in at 1-1/4" thick, the Inflex recoil pad enhances shooting comfort - something you'll certainly notice when sending magnum rounds downrange.
features: Vari-Tech Stock with Adjustable LOP and Comb
Sporter Contour Barrel with a Non-reflective Matte Blued Finish

products.description: The Browning X-Bolt holds a fine reputation as an accurate, reliable rifle that hunters can depend on. Sitting at the summit of the X-Bolt 2 line is the new White Gold Medallion, a rifle built to carry on that legacy with style. The X-Bolt 2 White Gold Medallion was developed for the hunter that prefers the tradition of a wood stock and appreciates the improvements that technology provides. The standout feature is the beautiful Grade V/VI walnut Monte Carlo-style stock with gloss finish and rosewood caps with white line spacer at the fore-end tip and grip cap. Touches like a rounded fore-end tip and point-style checkering retain the classic look, but like other X-Bolt models, this stock has a trim, nimble feel that is fast to the shoulder. A 1-1/4" Inflex recoil pad reduces the impact of felt recoil. The stainless steel action resists corrosion and looks sharp with the gray finish enhanced by engraving. The spiral fluted bolt assembly is polished to a sheen. Low profile bottom metal ensure the focus is on the stock and raises the bar of elegance. Focusing on performance, X-Bolt 2 Hunter is an ideal blend of tradition and design that will satisfy the accuracy needs of shooters. A stainless steel sporter contour barrel keeps the rifle light, maneuverable, and easy to carry. The action is bedded, and the barrel is free floated for consistent accuracy. A removable, stainless steel radial style muzzle brake reduces felt recoil and retains the lines of the rifle. A thread protector is included. Functionally, the action has been redesigned with additional bolt guidance surface for smoother cycling. The spiral fluted bolt has also been reworked and is fitted with an improved handle and bolt knob. The DLX Trigger is a three-lever design that offers zero creep, zero take-up, and zero overtravel performance and comes preset from the factory at 3.5 pounds. (Adjustable down to 3.0 pounds.)

Threaded muzzle brake reduces felt recoil (thread protector included)

products.title: BRN XB2 COMPOSITE STS 308WIN 22" 4RD
products.description: Built for tough environments, the new X-Bolt Hunter Composite Stainless is a rifle ready for adventure. Like all X-Bolt 2 rifles, the Hunter Composite Stainless is built on a new receiver design with additional bolt guidance surface for smooth, fast cycling. Stainless steel construction minimizes the corrosive effects of weather. The spiral fluted bolt shaves weight and includes a revised handle and knob shape for easier manipulation. The bolt assembly is treated with a silver nitride finish that is extremely resistant to corrosion. A lightweight, stainless steel sporter contour barrel offers a great blend of accuracy and weight savings. The muzzle is threaded M13x0.75 to accept the included stainless steel radial muzzle brake, thread protector cap, or install an optional Browning Recoil Hawg Sporter muzzle brake for extra reduction in recoil. The action is bedded and the barrel is free floated for consistent accuracy. The DLX Trigger is a three-lever design that offers zero creep, zero take-up, and zero overtravel performance and comes preset from the factory at 3.5 pounds. (Adjustable down to 3.0 pounds.). The stand-out feature is, of course, the black composite Vari-Tech stock. This configurable stock makes it easy to adjust the comb height to dial-in the alignment between your eye and optics. Length of pull is adjusted internally with spacers for a solid, rattle-free feel. Even the grip angle can be changed by switching between the sporter and vertical grip modules. On the subject of grip, contrasting gray rubber overmolding on the gripping surfaces provides added security in all conditions. Coming in at 1-1/4" thick, the new Inflex recoil pad enhances shooting comfort - something you'll certainly notice when sending magnum rounds downrange. When hunting, fractions of a second can determine success or failure. When fit to your dimensions, the Vari-Tech stock creates a rifle that feels like an extension of your body so you can get an accurate first shot off sooner and have faster, more accurate follow up shots.
features: Black Vari-Tech stock features adjustable length of pull, adjustable comb, interchangeable grip modules, and contrasting gray overmolded grip surfaces
Stainless steel receiver with non-reflective matte finish
Stainless steel sporter contour barrel with matte finish for the ideal blend of accuracy and weight savings
Spiral fluted bolt with ergonomic bolt knob and handle shape feature a corrosion-resistant silver-nitride finish
Stainless steel radial muzzle brake with matte finish reduces felt recoil (thread protector included)

products.title: BRN XBLT2 MICRO COMPOSITE 308WIN 20"
products.description: The Browning X-Bolt 2 features the Vari-Tech stock with three-way adjustment to dial-in the fit to meet your needs. Adjustments can be easily made to the comb height to dial-in the alignment between your eye and optics. Length of pull is adjusted internally with spacers for a solid, rattle-free feel. Even the grip angle can be changed by switching between the sporter and vertical grip modules. On the subject of grip, rubber overmolding on the gripping surfaces provides added security in all conditions. A shorter 1" Inflex Recoil Pad allows the length of pull to drop to a minimum of 12-7/8". While smaller shooters and those who hunt in climates that require additional layers of clothing will benefit from the Vari-Tech stock, the Micro also has a barrel that is 2" shorter than standard to reduce weight. The radial muzzle brake uses 5/8"x24 barrel threading that also makes it simple to add a suppressor. The Micro also has all of the performance-driven features of other X-Bolt 2 rifles, notably the DLX Trigger. This three-lever design offers zero creep, zero take-up, and zero overtravel performance and comes preset from the factory at 3.5 pounds. (Adjustable down to 3.0 pounds.)

With a number of enhancements, the new X-Bolt 2 Medallion Maple is set to shoulder that legacy with style. The X-Bolt 2 Medallion Maple was developed for the hunter that prefers the tradition of a wood stock and appreciates the improvements that technology provides. The standout feature is the beautiful AAAA maple stock with gloss finish and rosewood caps at the fore-end tip and grip cap. Touches like a rounded fore-end tip and point-style checkering retain the classic look, but like other X-Bolt models, this stock has a trim, nimble feel that is fast to the shoulder. Gloss blued finish on the engraved receiver, barrel, and bottom metal accentuates the stock and raises the bar of elegance. The spiral fluted bolt reduces weight and adds visual interest. Focusing on performance, X-Bolt 2 Hunter is an ideal blend of tradition and design that will satisfy the accuracy needs of shooters. A sporter contour barrel that keeps the rifle light, maneuverable, and easy to carry. The action is bedded, and the barrel is free floated for consistent accuracy. A removable, radial style muzzle brake reduces felt recoil and retains the lines of the rifle. A thread protector is included. The action has been redesigned with additional bolt guidance surface for smoother cycling. The bolt has also been reworked and is fitted with an improved handle and bolt knob. The DLX Trigger is a three-lever design that offers zero creep, zero take-up, and zero overtravel performance and comes preset from the factory at 3.5 pounds. (Adjustable down to 3.0 pounds.)
features: Engraved receiver with polished blued finish
Gloss finished AAAA checkered maple stock with rosewood fore-end tip and grip cap
Sporter contour barrel with gloss blued finish for the ideal blend of accuracy and weight savings
Spiral-fluted bolt with ergonomic bolt knob shape
Threaded muzzle brake reduces felt recoil (thread protector included)

products.title: BRN BAR MK4 HNTR 243WIN 22" 4RD BLK
products.description: Timeless in appearance yet modern in functionality. The BAR MK 4 Hunter Composite is the hunting rifle that establishes the standard for all other autoloaders worldwide, offering precision, speed, and a selection of calibers - including magnums - that no other hunting autoloader can rival. With the composite stock, this rifle withstands every hunting condition. It features shim adjustments for cast on and off, as well as for drop at comb. Regarding the comb, the SoftFlex cheekpad is elevated, ensuring that the shooter's eye is properly aligned with their optic. Additionally, the rubber overmolding on the gripping surfaces improves security in all conditions.
features: Integral Buffering System for Reduced Stress and Wear

products.title: BRN BAR MK4 DBM 308WIN 18.5" 10RD BK
products.description: The sporting BAR has a contemporary design that offers shooters and hunters a lightweight semi-automatic rifle with refinements not present in the most popular modern sporting rifles, including a short-stroke gas-piston design. The BAR MK 4 DBM customizes the BAR design with a detachable box 10-round magazine and magazine well instead of the standard hinged floor plate design. The Grade II Turkish walnut stock features shim adjustments for both cast on/off and drop at the comb. An oil finish not only highlights the wood's inherent beauty but also offers a protective shield against moisture. A fluted barrel provides an excellent combination of lightweight design and exceptional accuracy. The alloy receiver is built with an integrated Picatinny rail for mounting optics.
features: Alloy Magazine Well with Ambi Mag Release

products.title: BRAVO BCA FOR GLOCK 19 OWB BLK RH
products.description: The Bravo Concealment Adaptive (BCA) OWB concealed carry holster is designed to be the best outside the waistband option for everyday concealed carry. Their outside the waistband (OWB) holster fits your gun perfectly. This is because they design their molds in-house with the latest CAD design. They 3-D scan the actual gun and build a solid off the cloud for the most precise fit within three-thousandths of an inch. Whether you open carry or conceal carry, the BCA OWB holster rides high and close to the body for maximum concealment while perfectly fitting your gun. They also have a slight curve to help wrap around the natural curvature of your waistline. Bravo holsters have a very smooth pocket for a quick and pronounced, audible click when reholstering. Since the holsters are made specifically for your gun, it keeps it locked and tight with no movement when wearing your gun. This keeps the finish of your gun in very good condition.
features: Edges on holster are rounded for comfort
Holsters are curved to fit the contours of body
Belt loops are adjustable to create a desired cant for greater concealment
